messages:
alex: FYI I just applied a small terraform rename that changed the k8s secret name used by the prometheus-adapter. HPA external metrics are now returning 'no metrics' and some scale-ups are stuck. Anyone available for a quick async sync?

maria: ugh ok. which secret name was renamed? do you have the tf diff?

alex: old: "autoscaler-scrape-creds" -> new: "metrics-scrape-credentials". I missed updating the prometheus-adapter ConfigMap that mounts the secret name. TF rename was in k8s_secret.data block (was supposed to be a mechanical rename).

ben: that would definitely break external metrics. prometheus-adapter reads the bearer token from that secret for scraping some internal endpoints we use for HPA.

alex: quick mitigation plan I was thinking: either (A) revert the rename in TF, or (B) update the adapter config and restart it. Reverting TF is fastest if y'all prefer.

maria: don't revert — we've already propagated the secret rename to a couple clusters. let's patch the adapter. small patch and restart should be fine.

ben: agree with maria. steps: 1) update prometheus-adapter configmap to point to "metrics-scrape-credentials" 2) ensure RBAC still matches 3) rollout restart deployment/prometheus-adapter -n monitoring 4) watch HPA events.

alex: doing step 1 now. patch I'm applying:```yaml apiVersion: v1 kind: ConfigMap metadata: name: prometheus-adapter-config namespace: monitoring data: adapter.yaml: | rules: - seriesQuery: \"up\" resources: overrides: node: {resource: \"node\"} metrics: - name: custom_up metric: \"up\" secretName: \"metrics-scrape-credentials\" # updated from autoscaler-scrape-creds ``` (this is illustrative; actual file is longer)

infra-bot: [alert] prometheus-adapter deployment restarted by alex at 2026-03-12T18:05:12Z

maria: after restart, check: kubectl -n monitoring logs deployment/prometheus-adapter | grep "Serving metrics" and kubectl get hpa -A to see metrics values. also check prometheus-adapter pod env for MOUNTED_SECRET var.

ben: if HPA still says no metrics, run: kubectl describe hpa <name> -n <ns> and look for external metrics fetch errors. the adapter should log 401/403 if token invalid — that indicates the secret data keys changed not just the name.

alex: ack. logs show adapter started and no 401s now, but HPAs are still in Pending for a couple minutes. seems they recovered after adapter warmed up.

maria: great. one follow-up: update the terraform module that consumes the secret name (monitoring module) so it references the new name as a variable and add a note in the CHANGELOG about the rename. also add a short rollback playbook for secret renames (this bit already burned us twice).

ben: can we add a validation in CI that checks prometheus-adapter config references exist in cluster or in rendered manifests? even a simple lint that fails TF plans that rename secrets referenced by k8s manifests would prevent this.

alex: good idea. I'll open a tiny PR to the infra repo with a TerraTest/plan check that searches for secret name changes vs. k8s manifests.

maria: awesome. assign to alex for the PR and I'll follow up on the monitoring module change.

alex: assigned. thanks all. leaving notes in the TF PR and the incident doc. :thumbsup:
